newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Bekaert surges five percent.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bekaert surges five percent.

text.p: Shares in Belgian steel wire maker Bekaert surged five percent on Thursday as investors decided the stock had finally hit bottom, dealers said.
Bekaert was up 4.9 percent at 19,450 francs by 0950 GMT, helped by an article in the Wall Street Journal highlighting its recent underperformance.
"It was one of the main stocks in Belgium which was still quite cheap," said Patrick Millecam of Antwerp brokerage Corluy.
"Everyone thought it was a bargain, but it was a bit like a falling sword: it was dangerous to grab it when it was still going down," he added.
